title: Operator

fields.label: Where the rest lives
fields.message: Destinations supported are the Destinations checkboxes in the right-hand panel. Display order is the Order box under Page Attributes (lowest first). The title is the operator name as it appears publicly.

fields.label: Kind
fields.name: kind
fields.instructions: Escorted tour operators get an operator page under /escorted-tours/ with their tour cards. FIT suppliers show the destinations and ways to travel they serve and link to Custom journeys or Resorts & villas (plan §6.6). Abercrombie & Kent is escorted only (D26).

fields.label: Logo
fields.name: logo
fields.instructions: Deferred until each operator's brand guidelines have been checked (readiness doc). While empty the card shows the grey placeholder, which must not ship.

fields.label: Fit line
fields.name: fit_line
fields.instructions: The one line on the operator card. Who it suits, in your words.

fields.label: Fit note
fields.name: fit_note
fields.instructions: The operator page body: who it suits, who it doesn't, what's included, pace. In my words.

fields.label: Price band
fields.name: price_band
fields.instructions: A word or two, not a number: Premium, Luxury, Ultra-luxury.

fields.label: Inclusions
fields.name: inclusions
fields.instructions: One per line. What a typical trip with this operator includes.

fields.label: Ways to travel served
fields.name: ways
fields.instructions: FIT suppliers only. Decides which page the card links to and the trip types it lists (Card / Operator, FIT variant).

fields.label: Sea voyages at CruiseOomph
fields.name: cruiseoomph_line
fields.instructions: This operator also runs ship-based voyages, which are sold at CruiseOomph. Adds the one-line hand-off to the card and page. National Geographic Expeditions (D32).

fields.label: Website
fields.name: website
fields.instructions: Internal reference only. Never printed on the site.

description: One Operator record per vendor (plan §6.6, §8.1). Seven at launch (D25).
